steps.say: This sample is a block diagram of mndflow itself. Cards are modules; lines are how they depend and feed.
steps.next: Open Graph in the explorer to see the door and the fold.

steps.say: Graph holds the engine: types, fold, file, store, and check — a Door that heals what comes in. Ports on the frame are interfaces.
steps.next: Select check, or return to the root and open Canvas.

steps.say: check is a Door: the one place a log comes in, checked and healed. Its fields say what role it plays.
steps.next: Follow the feed chain to file and store, or go up and open Canvas.

steps.say: Canvas draws one open layer — cards, frames and routes. NodeCard mentions store through a proxy so the line can cross layers.
steps.next: Open NodeCard, or pick a note or group back at the root.

steps.say: A proxy stands in for a block that lives elsewhere — here, Graph's store — so a relationship can cross a structural boundary.
steps.next: Return to the root and select a note or the engine group.

steps.say: A note is a card of text, not structure. This one names the file rule: a file is the graph, not the log.
steps.next: Select the other note, or the engine group beside the modules.

steps.say: The other note names the session rule: the log is the truth — undo flips a step and folds again.
steps.next: Select the engine group, or a relationship line on the canvas.

steps.say: A group organises without structuring — engine and surface gather modules on this layer without becoming parents.
steps.next: Click a relationship line to see how joins differ from cards.

steps.say: A relationship joins exactly two elements. Directed edges carry depends / feeds; plain lines are mentions and ties.
steps.next: Keep exploring the sample, or collapse Page Intelligence when you are done walking.
